title: Lean Turkey and Bean Chili
seoTitle: Lean Turkey and Bean Chili | Firefighter Meal
shortDescription: Double-batch crock chili with kidney beans and fire-roasted tomatoes
subtitle: Double-batch crock chili with kidney beans and fire-roasted tomatoes
description: Ground turkey browns with onion and bell pepper, then simmers low with beans, fire-roasted tomatoes, and chili spices until thick enough to hold on a spoon.

steps.title: Brown turkey with aromatics
steps.instruction: In a large skillet over medium-high heat, brown ground turkey 8–10 minutes, breaking into fine crumbles until no pink remains and edges look lightly golden.

steps.title: Sweat onion and pepper
steps.instruction: Add onion and bell pepper to the skillet. Cook 6–8 minutes, stirring, until softened and onion turns translucent at the edges.

steps.title: Bloom spices and tomato paste
steps.instruction: Stir in garlic, chili powder, cumin, paprika, and tomato paste. Cook 2 minutes until paste darkens and spices smell toasty, not raw.

steps.title: Transfer to crock and simmer
steps.instruction: Scrape turkey mixture into a 8-quart slow cooker. Add beans, tomatoes, and broth. Stir, cover, cook on low 4–6 hours until chili is thick and flavors melded.

steps.title: Adjust seasoning at the line
steps.instruction: Skim excess fat if needed. Taste and adjust salt. Chili should coat the back of a spoon and beans should stay whole, not mushy.

proTips: A splash of apple cider vinegar at the end brightens long-simmered chili.
Double beans if feeding vegetarian crew—turkey can be omitted in half the pot.
Freeze flat quart bags for emergency backup meals on busy weeks.
tonightSpread: Cornbread squares baked in a sheet pan.
Shredded iceberg, sour cream, and hot sauce at a topping station.
leftovers: Chili over baked potatoes for a loaded second-day lunch.
Reduce leftover chili and use as nacho topping with melted cheese.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Classic hall chili flavor with less grease. Scales in a large crock and stays hot for late-arriving crew without drying out.
mealPrepNotes: Brown turkey the night before and refrigerate. Morning crew adds tomatoes and beans, starts crock on low by 10 a.m. Station: Keep crock on warm (not boil) at the line so beans stay intact and turkey stays tender. Station: Set out toppings bar: shredded cheese, jalapeños, cilantro, lime wedges. Station: Use a 8-oz ladle for consistent cup-and-bowl portions across the crew.
